## Core Practice Modes
- **Lessons Mode (1–50):** 50 progressive structured lessons starting from home row fundamentals (`asdf jkl;`), expanding to top row, bottom row, numbers, capitalization, and punctuation. Features real-time visual finger placement guidance.
- **Speed Test Mode (Timed):** High-precision WPM tests (15s, 30s, 60s, 120s) with live telemetry tracking gross WPM, net WPM, accuracy percentage, and consistency.
- **Code Mode:** Realistic code typing practice across 9 major programming languages (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C++, SQL, Go, Rust, and HTML/CSS). Drills brackets `{ [ ( ) ] }`, symbols, and operators.
- **Quotes Mode:** Hand-curated literature quotes for natural sentence flow and punctuation mastery.
- **Custom Mode:** Allows users to paste any custom syllabus, exam passage, or text file.
- **Keyboard Layouts:** QWERTY, Dvorak, Colemak, AZERTY.
- **Acoustic Feedback:** Authentic synthesized mechanical keyboard switch sounds (Cherry MX Blue, Brown, Red, Topre, and Thock) with volume control.

## Target Audiences
1. **Students & Young Learners (Ages 12–18):** Building lifelong 10-finger muscle memory without looking at the keyboard.
2. **Competitive & Government Exam Aspirants (Ages 18–25):** Practicing standard exam typing patterns for SSC CGL (DEST), SSC CHSL, Railway RRB, and clerical typing certifications requiring 30–50 Net WPM with 95%+ accuracy.
3. **Software Engineers & Knowledge Workers (Ages 20–38):** Boosting coding velocity, mastering bracket pairs, and exceeding 80–120+ WPM benchmarks.
